2609.09883.title: Forward-Free LLM Depth Pruning via Weight Redundancy
2609.09883.paper_summary: Depth pruning reduces large language model (LLM) inference cost by removing complete Transformer blocks. Activation-based methods collect hidden states through forward passes on calibration data, while existing forward-free methods score each Transformer block separately without measuring similarity between blocks. We propose Weight-Redundancy Pruning (WRP), a forward-free depth-pruning method that estimates inter-layer redundancy from checkpoint weights to select blocks without calibration data or model forward passes. WRP compares attention output and MLP down-projection weights across layers and combines their pairwise similarities with relative projection-scale information. The resulting all-pairs similarity matrix guides layer grouping and block selection. Across multiple pruning settings, model families, and downstream tasks, WRP consistently outperforms existing forward-free magnitude pruning and approaches the performance of activation-based methods.
2609.09883.paper_summary_zh: 深度修剪通過移除完整的Transformer區塊來降低大型語言模型（LLM）的推理成本。基於激活的方法通過在校準數據上進行前向傳遞來收集隱藏狀態，而現有的無前向方法則分別對每個Transformer區塊進行評分，而不測量區塊之間的相似性。我們提出了權重冗餘修剪（WRP），這是一種無前向的深度修剪方法，通過檢查點權重來估計層間冗餘，以選擇區塊，而無需校準數據或模型前向傳遞。WRP比較各層之間的注意力輸出和MLP下投影權重，並將它們的成對相似性與相對投影比例信息結合。生成的所有成對相似性矩陣指導層分組和區塊選擇。在多個修剪設置、模型系列和下游任務中，WRP始終超越現有的無前向幅度修剪，並接近基於激活的方法的性能。
2609.09883.author: Vincent-Daniel Yun et.al.
